lines: 【信号】纳指（原始打分67%）、标普（原始打分63%）｜模型无样本外区分度：未来20日上涨概率≈基率 62% · 实验性信号
【风险】⚠ VIX期限结构倒挂（28.2 ≥ 25.5）——恐慌状态，但历史上倒挂后20日胜率64.8%，往往接近底部；纳指20日年化波动 28%（高波动）
【提示】11-11（周三）为本周最佳入场窗口（68%），建议尾盘买入
【事件】11-06 非农就业(10月)；11-10 CPI发布(10月) —— 当日波动放大，避免重仓操作
lines_en: [Signal] NASDAQ (raw score 67%), S&P 500 (raw score 63%) | the model shows no out-of-sample discrimination: the 20-day probability of a gain is ~the base rate of 62% · experimental signal

[Risk] ⚠ VIX term structure inverted (28.2 >= 25.5) — a fear state, though historically the 20-day win rate after an inversion has been 64.8%, often close to a bottom; NASDAQ 20-day annualised volatility 28% (high volatility)
[Note] 11-11 (Wed) is this week's best entry window (68%); buying near the close is suggested
[Events] 11-06 Nonfarm payrolls (for month 10); 11-10 CPI release (for month 10) — volatility is amplified on the day; avoid large positions

lights.name: 趋势(MA200)
lights.note: 牛熊分界线，下方时一切看空信号加倍认真
lights.note_en: The bull/bear dividing line; below it, take every bearish signal twice as seriously.

lights.name: VIX期限结构
lights.note: 倒挂=恐慌（历史上倒挂后20日胜率64.8%，常近底部）
lights.note_en: Inversion = fear (historically the 20-day win rate after an inversion has been 64.8%, often close to a bottom).

lights.name: 收益率曲线(10Y-2Y)
lights.note: 倒挂(<0)是历史上最可靠的衰退预警，领先6-18个月
lights.note_en: An inversion (<0) is historically the most reliable recession warning, leading by 6-18 months.

lights.name: 信用利差(HY)
lights.note: 信用市场比股市先闻到危险；快速走阔=避险
lights.note_en: The credit market smells danger before equities do; a rapid widening means risk-off.
